clue.text: Home business with extremely meagre takings

parts.note: at home is in, so home gives IN
CO is the abbreviation for company, a business

indicators.note: extremely asks for the extremes of the next word, its first and last letters

explanation.surface: A home-based business is complaining that it makes very little money.
explanation.definitionFit: Takings are the money coming in, which is earnings or revenue.

clue.text: Apt to blow up, as calibre is all wrong

indicators.note: all wrong says the letters are wrongly ordered and must be rearranged

explanation.surface: A gun that might explode because its bore is the wrong size.
explanation.walkthrough: The anagram, signalled by 'all wrong', is of CALIBREIS; 'as' only joins. The gun picture makes 'blow up' sound like an explosion, but it means losing one's temper.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone quick-tempered is liable to fly into a rage.

clue.text: Trim dog twice?

parts.note: a cur is a dog
to dog is to tail, to follow someone

explanation.surface: A dog groomer is asked to clip the animal again.
explanation.walkthrough: 'twice' asks for 'dog' to be read in two senses: once as a noun, once as a verb meaning to follow.
explanation.definitionFit: To trim is to cut short, reduce.

clue.text: Belligerent citizens demanding letters in mail in time

indicators.note: the letters in the following words are demanded in a new order, an anagram

explanation.surface: Aggressive members of the public insist on getting their post on time.
explanation.walkthrough: The anagram, signalled by 'demanding letters in', is of MAILINTIME.
explanation.definitionFit: Civilians who take up arms as a part-time fighting force.

clue.text: Run in current, like some exotic fish

indicators.note: in tells us the letter for run is set inside the word for current

parts.note: current news is topical news
R is the cricket abbreviation for run

explanation.surface: A fish that swims into a current like the colourful exotic ones in an aquarium.
explanation.walkthrough: 'current' is the adjective (up to date), not a flow of water, despite the fishy surface.
explanation.definitionFit: Many brightly coloured aquarium fish come from hot equatorial waters.

clue.text: Scoundrel makes note on copy of will

indicators.note: in a down clue, on means the first piece sits on top of the next

parts.note: re is the second note of the sol-fa scale
probate is an official copy of a will certified by a court

explanation.surface: A villain writes a memo on a copy of a will.
explanation.definitionFit: An unprincipled rogue, a villain.

clue.text: Opening for 25 at sea

definitions.meaning: an aperture, as a gun-hole or porthole in a ship's side
the answer to 25 down names the side opposite starboard, and sailors have their own word for it

explanation.definitionFit: A gun-hole or aperture in a hull, and the nautical name for the larboard side of a vessel.

clue.text: In church, one opposed to alcoholic drink

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one
anti means against, opposed to

explanation.surface: A churchgoer is against drinking alcohol.
explanation.walkthrough: The teetotal surface hides a red wine.
explanation.definitionFit: A red wine from Tuscany is an alcoholic drink.

clue.text: Possibly synthetic product some call a textile

indicators.note: some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Some people would describe a man-made material as a fabric.
explanation.definitionFit: This milky emulsion is natural rubber sap or a synthetic polymer made to imitate it.

clue.text: He changes colour and sounds dreadful

indicators.note: sounds says the word for dreadful is said aloud to give the answer's spelling

parts.note: dire means dreadful

explanation.surface: A man who blushes and whose voice is awful.
explanation.definitionFit: A worker who stains cloth a new shade.

clue.text: How one hears of a universal recovery

parts.note: U is the film-classification abbreviation for universal
a rally is a recovery, as of prices or health

explanation.surface: A news item about how people hear of a general economic upturn.
explanation.definitionFit: The adverb means by way of the ear, which is the manner of hearing.

clue.text: Endure saucy little sibling's interrupting

indicators.note: interrupting means breaking into the middle of the other word

parts.note: saucy means cheeky, pert
SIS is a short form of sister, a sibling

explanation.surface: Someone has to put up with a cheeky younger sister barging in.
explanation.definitionFit: To endure is to keep going, to carry on despite difficulty.

clue.text: Conservative party attendant TV blabbermouth

parts.note: the Mad Hatter attended the tea party in Alice in Wonderland
the box is an informal name for television

explanation.surface: A Tory guest at a party is a chatty television personality who can't keep quiet.
explanation.walkthrough: The 'party' is the Mad Hatter's tea party from Alice's Adventures in Wonderland, not a political one, despite 'Conservative'.
explanation.definitionFit: A blabbermouth talks too much, an incessant talker.

clue.text: Gemstone in ring shown by New York Times

parts.note: a ring is round like the letter O
X is the multiplication sign, read as times

explanation.surface: A jewel worn in a ring, as reported by the New York Times newspaper.
explanation.walkthrough: 'New York Times' reads as the newspaper but splits into NY and 'Times', the multiplication sign X.
explanation.definitionFit: This banded chalcedony is a semi-precious stone used in jewellery.

clue.text: Useful quality hailed at first in natural player, now passe

indicators.note: in places the useful quality and the first letter inside the word for natural

parts.note: a born leader is a natural one
an asset is a useful quality

indicators.note: at first takes only the opening letter of hailed

explanation.surface: A gifted performer whose talent was once praised is now out of fashion.
explanation.definitionFit: An alto clarinet once loved by Mozart, now rarely played.

clue.text: Fortification's main part cut in two by conflict

definitions.note: read as fortification is, the 's linking definition to wordplay

indicators.note: cut in two by means the word is split and the other word goes into the gap

parts.note: the bulk is the main part of something
war is armed conflict

explanation.surface: A castle's main wall was split apart during the fighting.
explanation.definitionFit: A rampart or defensive wall is a fortification.

clue.text: Heard cat rouse bird

indicators.note: heard says the pet word for cat is said aloud

parts.note: kitty is a pet name for a cat
to wake is to rouse

explanation.surface: Someone heard a cat wake a bird.
explanation.definitionFit: A small gull named after its call.

clue.text: A graduate with vitality? What a surprise!

parts.note: an MA, Master of Arts, is a graduate
zing is energy, vitality

explanation.surface: Someone is astonished that a graduate could have any energy.
explanation.definitionFit: As an exclamation the word expresses astonishment, like 'incredible!'

clue.text: Grand to go to battle again — it bears fruit

parts.note: G is the abbreviation for grand, a thousand pounds
to re-engage is to join battle once more

explanation.surface: A general sets off to fight again, for a fruitful outcome.
explanation.definitionFit: A tree yielding green plums, and its fruit.

clue.text: Demanding English bloke defending team

indicators.note: defending means surrounding and guarding, so the team sits inside

parts.note: a gent is a man, a bloke
XI, eleven, is a cricket or football team

explanation.surface: A pushy Englishman is guarding his side.
explanation.definitionFit: Urgent or pressing requirements are exacting ones.

clue.text: It may thus enrage the Low- Churchman

definitions.text: It may thus enrage the Low- Churchman

parts.words: It may thus enrage the Low- Churchman
parts.note: a fragrant smoke used in high-church ritual both angers evangelicals and is itself a word meaning to anger

explanation.surface: An evangelical churchgoer is infuriated by smoky ceremony.
explanation.definitionFit: Fragrant smoke burnt in ritual, disliked by evangelicals; the same word as a verb means to anger.

clue.text: Directions covering European put under subjection

indicators.note: covering means wrapping round the other word

parts.note: ENE, east-north-east, is a compass direction built of directions
a Slav is a European of Slavic stock

explanation.surface: Orders given to a European subject him to control.
explanation.definitionFit: To subjugate someone is to make them a slave.

clue.text: It's an offence in the Orient, to be so stupid

parts.note: an is the indefinite article, the letter A
a sin is an offence
the Orient is the East, E

explanation.surface: Doing something so foolish counts as a crime in the East.
explanation.definitionFit: Donkey-like, so foolish or silly.

clue.text: Cut off part of weed

definitions.meaning: to shorten, as a tail or wages are cut
a coarse broad-leaved weed of the genus Rumex

explanation.definitionFit: To shorten by trimming, and a common broad-leaved wild plant.

clue.text: Leading journalist put up in regimental HQ

indicators.note: in a down clue put up means the letters are read upwards, in reverse

parts.note: top means leading, foremost
ED is short for editor, a journalist

explanation.surface: A senior reporter was billeted at army headquarters.
explanation.walkthrough: 'put up' turns the whole of TOPED, giving DEPOT.
explanation.definitionFit: A regiment's base where recruits are trained is its headquarters.

clue.text: Old man and I hit out for the county once

indicators.note: out signals the letters are thrown into a new order

explanation.surface: An old man and the speaker struck out at a former county.
explanation.walkthrough: The anagram, signalled by 'out', uses OLDMANIHIT; 'and' only joins. This was a Scottish county around Edinburgh, abolished in 1975.
explanation.definitionFit: A former Scottish shire surrounding Edinburgh, now a council area.

clue.text: A blow for those favouring radical socialism

definitions.meaning: a punch thrown with one particular hand, as a boxer's hook
the political wing of radicals and socialists

explanation.definitionFit: A boxer's punch from the non-dominant hand, and the radical wing of politics.

clue.text: Northerner misses start of race meeting

indicators.note: misses start of means the opening letter is dropped

parts.note: Ascot is a famous English horse-race meeting

explanation.surface: A northern visitor fails to arrive for the start of the races.
explanation.walkthrough: ASCOT, a famous racecourse in Berkshire, England, holds a celebrated race meeting.
explanation.definitionFit: A native of Scotland, north of England.

clue.text: Betel-leaf? Champion! A universal remedy!

parts.note: pan is the betel leaf chewed in South Asia
an ace is a champion, an expert

explanation.surface: Chewing betel leaf is hailed as a cure for everything.
explanation.walkthrough: 'pan' (paan) is the betel leaf, usually wrapped round areca nut and chewed in India.
explanation.definitionFit: A cure-all supposed to heal every ill.

clue.text: State supplying plants seen round Idaho

indicators.note: seen round means the plants word encloses the other

parts.note: flora is the plant life of a region
ID is the postal abbreviation for Idaho

explanation.surface: One American state supplies vegetation that grows around Idaho.
explanation.definitionFit: A US state in the south-east, the Sunshine State.

clue.text: Links repaired within a decade

indicators.note: within means one word is placed inside the other

parts.note: ties are links or bonds
to repair to a place is to go there, so repaired is went

explanation.surface: Chain links were fixed during a ten-year period.
explanation.walkthrough: 'repaired' looks like 'mended' or even an anagram signal, but means 'went', as in repairing to the bar.
explanation.definitionFit: Ten years such as 1920 to 1929 make one decade.

clue.text: One may be blessed after this involuntary expulsion

definitions.text: One may be blessed after this involuntary expulsion

parts.words: One may be blessed after this involuntary expulsion
parts.note: people say 'bless you' after this sudden expulsion of air through the nose

explanation.definitionFit: A sudden reflex blast through the nose often prompts a 'bless you'.
